consequence.statement: Loki will not start during the upgrade if the environment does not have tsdb and v13 schema configured, as structured metadata is now enabled by default.

original.statement: Structured metadata is enabled by default in Loki 3.0.0 and requires tsdb storage backend and v13 schema configuration; Loki will not start without these.

decision.reason: [ev-5dacaee98643] and [ev-8b7267b73a1c] say structured metadata is now on by default and needs the active schema to use both the `tsdb` index type and the `v13` schema, or Loki won't start. That is an unmet precondition that stops the upgraded Loki from starting, so it fits upgrade-blocked, and critical severity matches a service that does not start. [ev-7791a108cc39] and [ev-649f409b4be1] give the steps to take before upgrading: move to tsdb/v13 first, or set `allow_structured_metadata: false`. Either way the operator has to act, so this is mandatory work, not just review.
